threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You call it a ‘flat’ instead of an 'apartment' and wonder why everyone looks at you funny when you mention taking the Tube to get to Shoreditch.
Caught the 35 last night; some bloke was trying to barter with the driver for a free ride, claiming he had 'good vibes' instead of cash. Driver just laughed.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When you see a group of kids practicing breakdancing on the sidewalk while the kebab shop serves up at 3am. That's Neukölln in a nutshell.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find 24-hour Turkish döner stands where locals debate the best sauce at 3 AM. The energy is unmatched.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they order a burrito without guac and still give the cashier a nod like it’s a secret pact.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling on the bus today while a woman was ranting about her lost cat. Only in SF do you get street performers and real-life drama on the Muni.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but the true magic lies in the tiny plazas where locals sip vermut and ignore the rush.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newbie by the way they still try to order a 'café con leche' in the smallest bars, where it's just 'café' or 'cortado' that gets you anywhere.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of 'the underground'. It’s a dead giveaway, especially when you ask for the nearest station.
Saw a guy on the N133 last night arguing with a streetlight, convinced it was blinking back at him. Brixton after dark is something else.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a group of kids skateboarding on the roof of an abandoned building at Sonnenallee—where else but Neukölln would that happen?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find street performers in U-Bahn stations, mixing art and transit in a way that turns daily commutes into mini-concerts.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they know to avoid BART on Fridays after 5PM—nothing says ‘tourist’ like a confused look during a train delay.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy on the 5 Fulton trying to debate the moon landing with an EMT. The bus rolled up right as he yelled, 'I swear it was all green screens!'

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the Gaudí sights, but the real charm is in the corner bakeries where grandmas still make pastries.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they order a ‘café con leche’—most locals skip the extra milk and just go for a ‘café’.
